title: Clawd X Digest
summary: GPT-6 Astra Takes #1 Spot on Code Arena WebDev Benchmark: OpenAI's newly released GPT-6 Astra reached 1797 points on Arena.ai's WebDev leaderboard, surpassing Claude Fable 5.1 Max by 35 points while setting a new Pareto efficiency standard at $40/Mtoken.

Nike Removed from S&P 100 Following 80% Stock Decline: Nike is set to be removed from the S&P 100 index after 18 years, following a catastrophic stock drop driven by DTC distribution missteps and intense competition from Hoka and On Running.

Speculation Swirls Over Anthropic Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Claim: Tech commentators highlighted claims that Anthropic's Claude may have produced a proposed solution to the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem, currently under expert peer review ahead of Anthropic's anticipated IPO.

MicroStrategy Bitcoin Portfolio Hits $4.93B Unrealized Profit: Michael Saylor's treasury reserve strategy reached nearly $5 billion in net unrealized gains as Bitcoin price appreciation continues to bolster $MSTR asset balance sheets.

Luis Enrique & Bayern Munich Highlight European Football Dramas: PSG manager Luis Enrique shrugged off winless Ligue 1 pressure, while Bayern Munich's historic 67-matchday run at the top of the Bundesliga table came to an official end.

items.title: @arena: GPT-6 Astra Claims #1 Spot on Code Arena Leaderboard
items.body: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra (Max) captured the top position in Code Arena: WebDev with 1797 points (+35 over Claude Fable 5.1 Max), setting a new performance-to-cost benchmark at $40/Mtoken across Data & Analytics and Consumer Product tasks.

items.title: @AndrewCurran_: Viral Speculation Claims Anthropic Solved Navier–Stokes Problem
items.body: A viral analysis claimed Anthropic's Claude model generated a candidate proof for the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, currently undergoing confidential expert review prior to Anthropic's public listing.

items.title: @theo: Developers React to GPT-6 Astra Computer Control Speed
items.body: Developers noted that GPT-6 Astra's rapid asynchronous tool use and web navigation speed are prompting software engineers to rethink subscription tiers and personal workflow tooling.

items.title: @Acemation_: Elon Musk Warns the 200-Year Deal of Selling Hours is Ending
items.body: Highlighting upcoming labor disruption, Musk cautioned that workers have at most a decade left selling manual hours before AI agents execute the vast majority of economic work.

items.title: @quxiaoyin: AI Startups Ramp Up Unlimited Token Budgets for Vibe Coders
items.body: Startups are recruiting top-tier AI builders with unlimited token access—aiming for 1B tokens per developer per day—to accelerate agentic product development.

items.title: @poteto: Grok Android App Opens Pre-Registration on Google Play
items.body: The Grok team announced pre-registration for their native Android application alongside Grok Image 2.0 multi-modal generation updates.

items.title: @gregorykennedy: Nike Delisted from S&P 100 After 18-Year Tenure
items.body: Nike's stock drop of nearly 80% over 5 years resulted in removal from the S&P 100 index, sparked by a flawed pivot to direct-to-consumer sales that severed legacy retail partnerships.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: MicroStrategy Bitcoin Strategy Surpasses $4.93B Unrealized Gain
items.body: MicroStrategy's corporate treasury holdings recorded $4.93B in paper profit since initiating Bitcoin purchases in 2020, boosting market capitalization.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Robinhood CEO Reaffirms Commitment to Stock Tokens
items.body: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev confirmed the company's long-term backing for tokenized equities and integrated multi-asset trading.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Luis Enrique Responds to PSG Ligue 1 Title Pressure
items.body: PSG manager Luis Enrique dismissed concerns following three winless matches in Ligue 1, remaining firm in his prediction for PSG's title defense.

items.title: @FullTimeX_: Thierry Henry Comments on Julian Alvarez Atletico Situation
items.body: Football legend Thierry Henry voiced concern over Julian Alvarez's psychological strain and transfer speculation at Atletico Madrid following recent matches.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Bayern Munich Bundesliga Top Spot Streak Ends at 67 Matchdays
items.body: Bayern Munich's historic 67-matchday streak leading the Bundesliga standings officially came to an end following weekend league results.
